title: Enable bounded browser I/O overlap on plain CSV jobs
question: Do one-window source prefetch and batched asynchronous writes save time in the hosted implementation?
summary: Plain streaming saves 7.02 to 16.10 seconds. A single plain Partition uses source prefetch and saves 1.06 to 4.12 seconds.

workloads: File-backed 391 MiB and 977 MiB CSV, streaming and a single eight-key Partition.

validation.summary: Sixteen runs verify order within each group, exact contents, byte caps, marker and cleanup. Thirteen browser fault cases include in-flight source and coalesced write cancellation.

limitations: Integrated measurements use same-origin OPFS and Chromium on one WSL host. Earlier picker evidence qualifies the separate write prototype.
exclusions: Compressed codecs, batched Partition writes and multi-step pipelines.
